desc: The Task Force's opening move. On establishing the Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets on 11 February 2025, Chairman James Comer and Chairwoman Anna Paulina Luna sent letters to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and CIA Director John Ratcliffe requesting a briefing on all UAP-related records in their possession, with the stated goal of delivering transparency to the American people. The choice of recipients is itself an argument: Rubio was one of five Senate cosponsors of the Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Disclosure Act and had said publicly that officials with very high clearances approached the Senate Intelligence Committee alleging secret retrieval and reverse-engineering programmes; Ratcliffe had said as DNI that UAP exhibit technologies the United States does not have. The letters put the question to three officials who had already answered it, in public, from the other side of the executive-legislative line.
